Subject: Provisional uplift proposal for LaunchPad (Nov 6–10)

Hi team — draft proposal below, internal numbers for now. Attaching a formal PDF for your records.

Summary (provisional):
- Requested uplift: from 5M tokens/day -> 20M tokens/day, window Nov 6 00:00 UTC to Nov 10 23:59 UTC (5 days)
- Temporary rate: $0.0009 / token for uplifted consumption above baseline (provisional)
- One-time admin fee: $500 (setup + monitoring)
- Deferred billing: invoice issued on Nov 30, payment due within 30 days of invoice. Deferred billing approved conditionally upon receipt of PO by Nov 30 and a pre-auth hold of $25,000.
- Overrun protection: daily cap of $18,000 (ceiling) beyond which we throttle; any usage above ceiling will be flagged and subject to negotiated settlement.

Rationale: pricing reflects short notice operational costs and prioritization of capacity. We can offer a 15% concession on uplift rate if LaunchPad commits to a follow-on month-to-month minimum for December.

Attachments: provisional-pricing-quote.pdf

Next steps:
1) Sarah to confirm acceptance of the provisional terms and provide PO contact.
2) Ops to implement temporary quota and monitoring (we will need to set rate-limit and redirect to dedicated pool).
3) Finance to sign off on deferred invoice + pre-auth.

Mina: can you route approval to Aditya? Aditya: we need a quick green light for the pre-auth and deferred invoice path.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
